title: Very poorly constructed for a $45 item.
text: Very poorly constructed for a $45 item.. The item was poorly manufactured and poorly constructed. The outer burr ring was not secured and the plastic housing for it was too long which caused it to be loose within the body. I ended up having to break the plastic housing out, shave about 1/8th of an inch of plastic off the end, glue the burr ring into that, then glue the plastic housing back into the main body. I'm extremely disappointed with the poor design and construction considering I paid $45 for this item. It works great after I fixed it, but for the price, I shouldn't have had to risk breaking it to make it work properly.
